sloka: उत्तिष्ठोत्तिष्ठ राजर्षे कार्दमेय महाबल ।पुरुषत्वमृते सौम्य वरं वरय सुव्रत ।। ७.८७.१९ ॥
transliteration: uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha rājarṣe kārdameya mahābala ।puruṣatvamṛte saumya varaṁ varaya suvrata ।। 7.87.19 ॥

translations.english: Lord Shiva commanded, "Arise, arise, O royal sage, O son of Kardama, O mighty one; O gentle one, O one of good vows, choose any boon except for manhood."
